title: Business cards
slide_intent: Show how stock color, a single ink and the allocation of information to two sides can make a small card identifiable and easy to read.
strategic_value: The museum can vary the stock across cards while its black seal and a consistent contact hierarchy hold the set together.
demonstration: Production notes specify 85 × 55 mm cards, 350 gsm Colorplan stock and black ink. A six-card arrangement compares seal faces and two contact-detail layouts.
practical_value: Choose the stock and check that the seal and contact details reproduce clearly in one ink on both sides.

content_islands.name: Production specification
content_islands.spec: Place the page heading above a short list of dimensions, stock colors and print method at left.

content_islands.name: Seal faces
content_islands.spec: Show the black seal centered on yellow, pale, pink and turquoise cards, aligned in two rows.

content_islands.name: Contact sides
content_islands.spec: Use the rightmost column for two names and contact layouts. Keep the name apart from role and contact information.
